description: This file contains the implementation of the AOR_ReportsController class, which manages various actions related to report handling in the SuiteCRM system. It includes methods for fetching module fields, relationships, generating reports, exporting data, and rendering PDFs, among others.

classes.name: AOR_ReportsController
classes.description: Controller class for handling report-related actions in SuiteCRM using various protected and public methods.

methods.name: action_getModuleFields
methods.description: Fetches module fields for a specified module or related module based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_getVarDefs
methods.description: Returns JSON-encoded field definitions of a specified module.

methods.name: action_getModuleTreeData
methods.description: Retrieves and outputs module tree data for a specified module.

methods.name: action_getModuleRelationships
methods.description: Fetches relationships for a specified module.

methods.name: action_changeReportPage
methods.description: Changes the report page view based on provided offset and group parameters.

methods.name: action_getParametersForReport
methods.description: Retrieves report conditions as parameters for a given report record.

methods.name: action_getChartsForReport
methods.description: Fetches linked chart data for a specified report.

methods.name: action_addToProspectList
methods.description: Adds report results to a prospect list by establishing relationships.

methods.name: action_chartReport
methods.description: Generates a chart report using the report bean.

methods.name: action_export
methods.description: Exports report data to CSV after ACL check.

methods.name: action_downloadPDF
methods.description: Generates and outputs a PDF version of a report with charts embedded.

methods.name: action_getModuleFunctionField
methods.description: Returns an HTML select element or label for module functions.

methods.name: action_getModuleOperatorField
methods.description: Returns operator options based on field type, for filtering or conditions.

methods.name: action_getFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for selecting field types based on module field definition.

methods.name: action_getActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Provides options for action types based on module field definitions.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldType
methods.description: Dynamically returns input elements for selecting module fields, dates, or predefined options.

methods.name: action_getModuleFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Similar to above but for setting module fields, with support for different types.

methods.name: action_getModuleField
methods.description: Returns HTML element for module field selection.

methods.name: action_getRelFieldTypeSet
methods.description: Returns related model fields for selection.

methods.name: action_getRelActionFieldTypeOptions
methods.description: Returns options for related action fields.
